Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5210); Ninevi (i.e. Nineveh), the capital of Assyria:--Nineve.
BiblicalUsage: Nineveh itself never stands alone as a word in the Greek New Testament. The city that Jonah preached to is named in Hebrew, but in the Greek text only its people appear — the men of Nineveh who repented at Jonah's preaching.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the missing name is a lesson in itself: the city is known by its people, and its people are known by their repentance.
